# ScramServerRegion

*Server*

Named file-backed region from c.getServer().getRegion(id) or c.getWorld().getRegion(id). Corners are absolute fractional world coordinates; the region spans exactly between them. Setters persist regions.json and synchronize clients immediately. UUID binding survives rename and chunk unload. Deletion/world reload invalidates the handle. Live operations require the server game thread; stale handles throw IllegalStateException. Persistence failures throw IllegalStateException and retain the previous catalog.

## Methods

### getUuid {#getuuid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — persistent UUID, also readable after this region is removed

:::

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether this region still exists in the original world catalog; chunk unload does not affect it

:::

### getRotation {#getrotation}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the rotation of the region around its middle in degrees: x pitch, y yaw, z roll

:::

### setRotation {#setrotation}

::: member

Turns the region around its middle, like a collision: roll, then pitch, then yaw. Entities count as inside the turned box; [`getMin()`](#getmin) and [`getMax()`](#getmax) stay the corners before the turn.

```js
c.getServer().getRegion("bridge").setRotation(0, 45, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around X in degrees |
| `yaw` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around Y in degrees |
| `roll` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around Z in degrees |

**Returns** [`ScramServerRegion`](/scripting/server/ScramServerRegion) — this region

:::

### getMin {#getmin}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — detached lower corner of the region before its rotation, inclusive

:::

### getMax {#getmax}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — detached higher corner of the region before its rotation, exclusive

:::

### getNbtCompound {#getnbtcompound}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — detached complete settings; use setNbtCompound to apply changes

### setNbtCompound {#setnbtcompound}

::: member

Replaces all settings of the region (dimension, corners, triggers) with the data, saves it and synchronizes clients.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settings` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | complete region settings, not null; copied and validated; UUID identity is preserved |

:::

### rename {#rename}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |

### remove {#remove}

::: member
